title: vote.trivia.result
description: server → host and clients. Outcome of the trivia sudden-death. With a winner, vote.stage TIEBREAK_PICK follows; without one, the coin flip decides and vote.result follows. An outcome-log message: the host awards the 30 knowledge score points to the winner.

outcomeSeq.description: Position in the room outcome log.

winnerId.description: First player to answer correctly; null when nobody did.

DataId.description: Identifier of an entry in the shared game data (`data/`): part, part category, contract, test, anomaly card, minigame, fact, codex entry, callout, console request, award, objective, validation rule, cosmetic. 1–48 characters.

OutcomeSeq.description: Position of a server-resolved outcome in the room outcome log; starts at 1 and increases by 1 per outcome for the lifetime of the room.

PlayerId.description: Player identifier, unique within a room and never reused: "p" followed by a positive integer (p1, p2, …).

RoundId.description: Vote round identifier chosen by the host; unique within the room for its whole lifetime.
